description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application, defining the main widget structure for a calculator frontend app. It sets up the MaterialApp, a home page with a scaffold, app bar, and a simple centered message with a progress indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter application, defines the MaterialApp with title, theme, and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the application's home page, displays the main scaffold with app bar and central content.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage, builds the UI with scaffold, app bar, and centered message and progress indicator.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; invokes runApp with MyApp instance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp, MyHomePage, and _MyHomePageState.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for MyHomePage widget.
